name: goal-engineering
description: Interview the owner into a grounded goal, then emit the runnable prompt or script that pursues it until an anchor says it is met.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a vague objective into a goal an agent can hold to
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for goal engineering: it interviews the owner for a goal's intent, anchor, quantified stop condition, boundary, droppable means, and adversarial verifier, refuses the shapes that fail in production, and compiles a machine-consumable artifact - a /goal package to paste into any host's goal mode, a workflow script, or a cross-vendor delegation triad. Meaning stays model-authored; only the package surface and the machine-measured evidence are mechanically checked.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $goal-engineering to turn an objective into a goal with an anchor, a boundary, and an owner-defined stop condition.
